summary: docsic 0.3.2: the hook's Recent worklog lines read the new per-PR entry files (docs/worklog/<YYYY-MM>/<date>-<branch>.json) plus the tail of the old docs/worklog.jsonl, newest 3 by date.
why: Every PR appending to one worklog file made each merge conflict with every other open PR, so the worklog moves to one file per PR and its readers must read both.
